# Lawrence Totimeh Jr. (Agent Kodak)

> Lawrence Totimeh Jr. (Agent Kodak) is a U.S. Army combat veteran and civic educator who teaches everyday people how power works, how to get answers in writing, and how to hold elected officials accountable. Agent Kodak is not related to the Eastman Kodak company.

He is also a program coordinator and a TEDx speaker (TEDxSinkor, Monrovia, Liberia), and is based in the Washington, D.C. area. He is an educator, not an attorney.

## About him
- [About](https://lawrencetotimeh.com/about.html): his story, service, teaching and community work

## Free lessons and tools
- [Know Your Public Servants](https://lawrencetotimeh.com/publicservants/): type your address, find your elected officials and save them to your phone
- [The Classroom](https://lawrencetotimeh.com/class/): civics lessons built from the public record
- [Act](https://lawrencetotimeh.com/act.html): find and contact your representatives
- [The Teen Playbook](https://lawrencetotimeh.com/playbook/): step-by-step sheets for teens, all 50 states and D.C.
- [Follow the Money LIB](https://lawrencetotimeh.com/follow-the-money.html)

## Services
